description: Search the 431 free calculators and converters on nanocalcs.com by keyword (any language). Returns id, name, page URL, accepted prefill parameters and an example prefilled URL. Use the id with build_link to give the user a page with their own numbers filled in.

locale.description: Page language for links, e.g. en, ko, ja, es, de. Default en; falls back to English when a tool has no page in that language. Available: en, ja, ko, en-IN, id, ar, tr, ms, es, pt-BR, fr, de, it, ru, pl, nl, vi, th, zh-CN, zh-TW, hi, bn, ur, fa, uk, ro, cs, hu, el, sv, fil, he, sw, af, ckb, bg, da, nb, ta, zu, kab, sk, az, fi, lv, ne, is, ht, tpi, uz, kk, ky, be, am, sq, ka, sr, km, lo, si, hr, sl, et

query.description: What the user needs, e.g. "mortgage payment", "tokens", "나이 계산"

name: find_tool
title: Find a nanocalcs tool
